content: We evaluate the output of all systems using human evaluation. The metric is denoted as Simplicity BIBREF8 . The three non-native fluent English speakers are shown reference sentences and output sentences. They are asked whether the output sentence is much simpler (+2), somewhat simpler (+1), equally (0), somewhat more difficult (-1), and much more difficult (-2) than the reference sentence.
